title: Once Plus is on, a paying member whose phone cannot reach Google Play's payment part is told their account has no Plus
what: When the app's Google Play payment part fails to load (or the phone has none, such as an iPhone), the failure is swallowed with no log. Buy then says Google Play is not available, but I already paid skips the check and answers 'This Google account has no MettleUp Plus.' A member who did pay reads a wrong fact, their paid features stay locked, and MettleUp never hears the payment part was missing. Plus buying is still switched off, so nobody meets this yet.
expected: When there is no store to ask, I already paid says Google Play is not available right now, the same as Buy, and the missing payment part is logged.
who: members who paid for Plus, once payments go live
how_often: every time the payment part is missing
fix_line: Make I already paid answer 'not available' when there is no store, and log the load failure

title: A damaged saved list of help questions is quietly emptied and then overwritten, losing the MettleUp team's answers
what: If the saved list of questions on the phone cannot be read back, the app treats it as empty, logs nothing and marks the read as good. The next question asked saves over it, so every earlier question, and the key needed to fetch the team's reply to it, is gone for good. The member sees an empty list with no word why. The app writes this list itself, so damage is rare.
expected: A list that cannot be read is logged and kept aside, not overwritten, so earlier questions and replies can still be found.
how_often: rarely, only after the saved list is damaged
fix_line: Log a damaged list and keep it aside instead of saving over it
